test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some P are T.

II. No T is Z.

**Conclusions:**

I. No P is Z.

II. Some Z are not P.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follows

solution:
Statements:

I. Some P are T.

II. No T is Z.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406d2c6b471d1089d0506139f538a1082a8c4e1154166d7a6370aac7497e07f7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No P is Z→ False (No direct relationship given between P and Z).

II. Some Z are not P → False (No direct relationship given Z don't relate to P).

Hence, **"****Neither conclusion follows"**.
